fnol_text: My name is Tariq Ishikawa and I live at 514 Marigold Terrace, Milton, VT 05416. You can reach me on (555) 288-7253 or tariq.ishikawa@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 7 July 2023 when the car behind, driven by Rafael Iyer, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2023-00142. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Ishikawa on (555) 288-7253 to acknowledge the claim. Tariq confirmed the loss date as 7 July 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Grace Gallagher gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Rafael Iyer reports a mild concussion and attended County General. Tariq reports whiplash.
